correctness.rationale: At zero second-moment memory the source max statistic is exactly the largest squared gradient norm seen so far. On an isotropic quadratic this gives the radial recurrence x_next=(1-c/R)x. The three cases follow by one-step comparison with the initial radius. In the supercritical case the first radius is A times the initial radius and immediately freezes the max; direct substitution then gives the fixed multiplier -1/A, proving all formulas and the sharp reciprocity.

value.rationale: Robustness to the global base learning rate is the defining theoretical motivation for AdaSGDMax. The exact law quantifies the hidden transient cost of that robustness: arbitrarily large base rates are stabilized by a single running-max reset, but the first objective spike grows exactly as the reciprocal of the later contraction. This gives a precise transient-versus-rate tradeoff not visible in the source convergence theorem.
